Vide this order, aforementioned appeal and cross objections are being decided.

2.  Briefly stating, certain land belonging to the cross cross-objectors objectors came to be acquired vide notification dated 13.03.1981 issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1984 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') followed by notification dated 09.07.1991 issued under Section 6 thereof.
The award under Section 11 was passed o on n 09.03.1992 whereby compensation was assessed by the Land Acquisition Collector at the uniform rate of Rs.2,60,000/ Rs.2,60,000/- per acre.

The land under acquisition formed part of Village Kumbra, the then Tehsil Kharar, District Rupnagar for the purpose of setting u up of National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Research,, SAS Nagar.
